# BMMC Showcase

> Digital museum and New Zealand heritage hub: artifact catalog, photo/currency/stamp archives, NZ history maps, and interactive MTB trail maps.

BMMC is a static HTML/JS website. Navigation source of truth: `shared-nav.js`.

For agent reading, prefer the full guide linked below. Use HTML pages when UI or live behaviour matters.

## Docs

- [BMMC full site guide](llms-full.md): Combined clean markdown for all key hub pages (museum, maps, MTB, blueprint)

## Live pages (HTML)

- [Navigation Hub](index.html): Spider directory, search, On this day
- [Museum Showcase & Catalog](museum.html): Artifacts, 3D models, gramophones (`#stats` analytics)
- [Museum Artifact Origin Map](2Dmap.html)
- [Artifact Care & Restoration](restoration-guide.html)
- [Historical Photo Archives](gallery.html)
- [NZ Currency & Minting](currency.html)
- [NZ Stamp Archive](stamps.html)
- [Philatelic Photo Map](2Dmap_stamps.html)
- [Trimble NZ History Wall](trimble.html)
- [NZ MTB & Cycle Trails](mtb.html): GPX/KML/KMZ import, elevation profiles
- [Friction-Drive Wedge-Lock Blueprint](Interactive_Friction-Drive_Wedge-Lock_Blueprint.html)
- [Aotearoa NZ History Map](nz_history.html)
- [Aotearoa NZ Railway Map](trains.html)
- [Aotearoa NZ Maritime & Coastal Map](maritime.html)

## Optional

- [shared-nav.js](shared-nav.js): Menu / wing directory
- [shared-map.js](shared-map.js): Leaflet map helpers
